newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-COMMISSIONER SAYS PARCELLS IS BOUND TO PATRIOTS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-COMMISSIONER SAYS PARCELLS IS BOUND TO PATRIOTS.

text.p: NFL commissioner Paul Tagliabue said Wednesday New England Patriots' coach Bill Parcells, rumoured to be headed to the New York Jets, cannot coach another NFL team this year without the consent of Patriots' owner Bob Kraft.

After the 1995 season, Kraft agreed to shorten Parcells five-year contract, making it expire at the end of the just completed season in which the Patriots went to the Super Bowl last Sunday where they lost 35-21 to the Green Bay Packers.
But Parcells' contract gave Kraft the right to employ Parcells if he chose to coach in 1997.
Parcells, whom it was rumoured would become the general manger of the Jets as well as their coach, reportedly has feuded with Kraft over control of personnel decisions with the Patriots.

According to Tagliabue, Parcells could pursue other business opportunities, such as broadcasting or non-coaching positions. There was no indication whether Parcells could take a team's general manager's job, then assume the coaching duties one year later.

Tagliabue based his ruling on a portion of the amended contract which said if Parcells wanted to coach elsewhere and the Patriots still wanted him the contract would be extended thorugh the 1997 season.
Tagliabue held a one-hour conference call Tuesday with attorneys for Kraft and Parcells.
As commissioner, Tagliabue has the authority to resolve such disputes under the NFL's constitution and by-laws.
Newsday reported Wednesday that the agent for Parcells, Robert Fraley, said his client will not return to New England for the 1997 season regardless of the commissioner's ruling.
Prior to the Super Bowl, there were reports that the Patriots had lined up San Francisco 49ers defensive coordinator Pete Carroll to replace Parcells.
The request for a hearing by both parties appeared to finalise the divorce between the Patriots and Parcells, who guided the team to its first Super Bowl appearance in more than a decade.
Parcells may still try to bolt to the Jets, with Kraft offering consent in exchange for the first overall pick in the April draft, which belongs to the Jets.

The Jets were reported set to offer Parcells complete control of their football operations which he once had in New England until Kraft turned over draft duties to director of player personnel Bobby Grier. A disagreement over last year's draft selections began the rift between Parcells and Kraft.
Parcells is just the second coach in NFL history to take two organisations to the Super Bowl. He coached the New York Giants to victories in Super Bowls XXI and XXV.
Parcells is 119-86-1 in 12 seasons as an NFL coach, including 10-5 mark in the playoffs.
